taken_over_from: B07/B14/B19/B37/B50 original local save path and Steam guards
hypothesis: User-generated APK86 CL world save blobs can be actually deserialized by original compiled SaveAndLoad.Load<T> with SHA-authenticated exact original Assembly-CSharp and dependencies; this distinguishes broken NRBF/save data from Android host lifecycle without claiming device success.
approach: Pin CL main commit and three genuine public-CL RGD blob identities (one small new world and two ~310KB saves), stage only those bytes in ephemeral Actions; run actual original CLR formatter and compiled generic Load<T> under strict size/hash guards and closed exception categories. Never upload or print user game data, original code, paths or private identifiers.
next_step: Write standalone guarded original actual-RGD CLR loader and path-scoped workflow, trigger once and report whether known CL user-generated saves load; retain LOCAL-005 open until Android offline gameplay, save and full-relaunch.
